title: Teentaal with a tihai
note: Teentaal theka at medium tempo for four cycles, then a cycle that starts the theka and plays a tihai: the phrase 'tirakita dhin na dha' three times with a one-beat gap, so its last dha falls on sam, beat 1 of the next cycle. A sitar plays a tanpura-like drone on D; the tabla's dayan is tuned to D. Not yet checked by a tabla player.

bols.tabla: dha dhin dhin tirakita | dhin na dha - | tirakita dhin na dha | - tirakita dhin na
